name: Invisibility
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

A creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything it is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it continues to wear or carry it. The spell ends if the creature attacks or casts a spell.

Roll Lore to see if you trigger any additional effects.

Describe how they turn invisible.
successes:
✨: If the creature attacks, the spell only ends if the attack hits.

🌞: The spell does not end if the creature attacks or casts a spell.

💀: The spell fails to make the creature invisible. Instead, a random object they are wearing or carrying becomes permanently invisible. Check a Condition.
